batch.topic: A station announcement moves a departure to another platform without changing the departure time; a train on the old platform is a different service.
A visitor may return a rented camera at a second branch only after notifying the first branch; distinguish pickup location from allowed return location.
A boat operator offers an alternative departure if the booked one is cancelled; an alternative is not automatically a confirmed replacement.
A campsite booking includes a tent pitch and excludes equipment rental; an arrival message is not a request to provide a tent.
